data.name: The job (+ DB clock, lease flag, lease_until, due; request: prevStatus, action, saveAs, nonce, fingerprints)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted, j.line_count,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.prevStatus')), NULL) AS prev_status,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL) AS req_action,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.saveAs')), NULL) AS req_save_as,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.nonce')), NULL) AS req_nonce,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.lineFingerprint')), NULL) AS line_fp,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.incomingFingerprint')), NULL) AS incoming_fp
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_LCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT st.step_name, st.step_status FROM gd_publish_step st WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.jobId}}' AND st.step_name REGEXP '^L[0-9]_' AND st.is_deleted = 0
SELECT j.prepared_payload FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_LCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS lot_id, g.stock_movement_status, CAST(g.lot_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS lot_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('SMLT|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 5)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN sm_location_transfer g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 5) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_LCguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^LOT\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(t.id AS CHAR), 'job_line_key', t.job_line_key, 'status', t.status, 'transit_qty', t.transit_qty,
       'received_qty', t.received_qty, 'open_qty', t.open_qty, 'received_date', DATE_FORMAT(t.received_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS j
  FROM in_transit_detail t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_LCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_LCentry.data.lotId}}'
   AND t.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_LCentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND t.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY t.id
